morning.text: 5 months later...

morning.name: Developer
morning.text: Hey, playtester, check this out. I made a new game!

morning.name: Developer
morning.text: I think you’ll really like this one! I never put much lore in those other games, and I figured I could work on a story-driven experience this time.

morning.name: Developer
morning.text: It is my first time, though… I’m quite nervous… please don’t judge it too hard… Um, go ahead.
A giant dungeon beast lies before you. “This is it,” you think. "The monster’s reign of terror will come to an end."
You lunge towards it with a vicious cry. The beast quickly dodges out of the way, opening its maws for an attack. It screams a blood-curdling cry at you…

morning.name: The Beast
morning.text: beep beep beep
The beast’s roar sounds oddly like an alarm clock.
You realize that it wasn’t a beast at all, and was, in fact, your alarm clock.
That’s right, it’s a Monday. You’re supposed to start at your new school today as the new transfer student.
You pick yourself out of bed and quickly throw yourself together, rushing downstairs to the bus.
A day like any other - not a problem in sight. Just you, waiting at the bus stop.

morning.name: Developer
morning.text: I figured that if I want to focus on storytelling, then I need to focus on the characters. And what better genre to do that than in a dating sim!
You hear the voice of another in your head. You’re not sure where it's coming from, as there is no one else nearby. Yet, it still sounds so familiar as if you heard it before in another life.
In fact, it's almost like there's two voices. One describes your life, addressing you in second person, while the other talks to you directly.

morning.name: Developer
morning.text: Well, I guess, this would be the first time I’ve given the player character any kind of personality. Have fun you little lovebird!
As you listen to the narrating voice in your head, you hear the sounds of the bus screeching to a stop in front of you. This is your ride to school.
You clamber onto the bus behind your friend. As you walk down the aisle, you spot a few available seats.

morning.name: Familar Voice
morning.text: Hey, c’mon, what’re you waiting for! Come sit by your good old friend Perri and let’s talk about how exciting it is that we both are going to the same school like old times!

Perri pats the seat next to them near the back, but the bus pulls away and starts shaking, almost making you lose your balance. Maybe it’s best if you take a closer seat. You look to the other available seat right next to you, where you spot a guy in a varsity jacket on the phone.
Amongst the loud voices of students talking to each other, you overhear someone on the other side loudly say the name Rowan, grabbing their attention.
There’s also the seat to your right where an imposing blue figure looms, filling the air with a sense of royalty. You feel a sense of deja vu, despite never having met.
Where will you choose to sit?

options.text: Carefully make your way to the back next to Perri
Play it safe and sit next to Rowan
Figure out why you’re getting such strong deja vu

chemistry.text: You wind your way down the halls of Sintax Academy and find your room in the chemistry lab with a few other students.
Navigating this place is like a labyrinth, and by the time you actually arrive, most of the seats are taken, and the professor has already arrived.
You notice the teacher is… the bus driver? Well anyways, he appears to be talking to a shorter, nerdy-looking girl with glasses.
I got everything set up for class. I also put out the elements we had on the countertops for people to look at.
chemistry.name: Girl with Glasses
Bus Driver
chemistry.text: Thank you, Gemini. You can go take your seat now.
Oh, good, you’re here. *Ahem* Good morning, class, and welcome back to school.
chemistry.name: Professor Hermit

chemistry.text: As you all probably know, my name is Professor Hermit. I won’t tolerate anyone who doesn’t call me by that name.
chemistry.name: Professor Hermit

chemistry.text: This year, we have a new transfer student. Why don’t you go ahead and introduce yourself?
chemistry.name: Professor Hermit

chemistry.text: Actually, never mind, we’ve got a busy class today, so you go ahead and find a seat.
chemistry.name: Professor Hermit

chemistry.text: You look around at the empty seats.
You notice that fit jock from the bus, Rowan, is here too. Although you don’t know him well, a familiar face is still familiar.
Then again, there is that nerdy girl, Gemini, who could be a great help in this class.
In the back, there’s one more seat. Once again, King Circle dominates the area, noticeably alone.
Who will be your chemistry partner?

options.text: Ask Gemini for help as your lab partner
Take a seat next to Rowan

history.text: A look through the doorframe gives you a sense of deja vu. Framing the entire classroom, historical paintings of the Great Shape War tell epic tales of pride and tragedy, victory and remorse.
Maps of the continents are plastered in between the paintings, the laminate bubbling near the edges, indicating their age.
You enter near the back of the classroom, next to the bookshelves filled with dusty, unused history books. You take a closer look at them, noticing a few book titles that seem vaguely interesting.
Your lungs are immediately filled with the musty air. You pull back and look towards the windows where the late sunrise rays pour through the far side windows, creating an air of calm.

Light pours over your childhood friend, Perri, who is looking longingly out the window. As you idle in the doorway, Gemini filters in behind you with a few more students and chooses a spot near the front of the classroom.
You look at the clock at the front of the room which tells you that class will be starting soon. The only empty spot is near the middle.
You set your backpack down next to it and climb into the tiny seat. Professor Hermit picks up some chalk and begins drawing on the board.
To begin this class, I would like to ask you all a question. Why do we study history?
history.name: Professor Hermit

history.text: A voice mumbles in the back of the classroom.
To learn about my great feats!
history.name: King Circle

history.text: You swivel in your chair. Somehow, you once again find yourself in the same class as the blue king.
Yes… from a certain angle, history is purely the study of past events, but think deeper. What makes history important to learn? That is the question to keep in mind throughout this semester.
history.name: Professor Hermit

history.text: Back when I was a young shape, I used to think the same way. I was–
history.name: Professor Hermit

history.text: I don’t recall asking you about your life story.
history.name: King Circle

history.text: But it could be yours too, because the things that have come to shape my life, now become to shape yours and everyone else’s futures.
history.name: Professor Hermit

history.text: We all have our own stories, facing difficulties with choice and living through the consequences to be here where we are in the present.
history.name: Professor Hermit

history.text: Which is why history class is more than a study and lecture, it is the opportunity for you students to forge your own story.
history.name: Professor Hermit

history.text: Since every story needs to start somewhere, how about you all get into groups of two and introduce yourselves?
history.name: Professor Hermit

history.text: Who will be in your group?

afterSchool.text: You just finished a day of school. Tired, you return home and go to bed.
